units.source_text: 正在此际，源氏大将得赦，驾返京都了。

en.t: Just then, General Genji was pardoned and returned to Kyoto.

units.source_text: 普天之下，欢呼之声载道。

en.t: Throughout the realm, cries of rejoicing filled the roads.

units.source_text: 不论男女，都争先恐后地要向大将表明自己的心迹。

en.t: Men and women alike hurried to show the general where their hearts stood.

units.source_text: 大将观察了这高高下下许多男女的用心，

en.t: The general observed the intentions of many men and women, high and low,

units.source_text: 但觉人情厚薄不同，不禁感慨无量。

en.t: and, seeing how human feeling differed in depth and warmth, he could not help being deeply moved.

units.source_text: 由于事绪纷忙，他竟不曾想起末摘花来，

en.t: Because affairs were so busy and tangled, he never even thought of Suetsumuhana,
and before he knew it, many days and months had passed.

units.source_text: 末摘花想道：“现在还有什么指望呢？

en.t: Suetsumuhana thought, "What hope is there now?

units.source_text: 两三年来，我一直为公子的飞来横祸而悲伤，

en.t: For these two or three years, I have grieved over the sudden calamity that befell the prince,

units.source_text: 日夜祷祝他像枯木逢春一般地再兴。

en.t: and day and night I prayed that he would rise again like a withered tree meeting spring.

units.source_text: 他返都之后，瓦砾一般的下贱之人都欣欣向荣，

en.t: After he returned to the capital, even lowly people no better than rubble flourished,

units.source_text: 共庆公子升官晋爵，而我只得风闻而已。

en.t: all celebrating the prince's promotion and new rank, while I could only hear rumors of it.

units.source_text: 他当年获罪流放，忧伤离京，

en.t: When he was punished and exiled that year, leaving the capital in sorrow,

units.source_text: 我只当作‘恐是我身命独乖’之故呢。

en.t: I thought it must be because my fate alone had gone awry.

units.source_text: 她怨天尤人，心碎肠断，只管偷偷地哭泣。

en.t: She blamed heaven and resented others, heartbroken and devastated, and did nothing but weep in secret.
